_doc: The LAG's 6-max-only settings (M2, the LAG retune at 6-max; spec
docs/ai-dlc/specs/m2-lag-6max-retune.md section 5). Merged over
content/personas/lag.json by load_persona_packs(table_size=6) only; 9-max
play never reads this file. Targets are frozen in
docs/ai-dlc/research/bot-realism-6max/m2-lag-retune.md. Before/after
figures below are pooled seeds 1-5, 6,000 simulated 6-max hands each,
95-105bb stacks, never the judged seed 20260926.
preflop.unopened: emitted verbatim by tools/rr_emit.py from
ladders/six_max/lag.unopened.json; edit the spec and re-emit, never these
nodes (test_rr_emit.py fails on drift). Targets are measured RFI LJ 20,
HJ 23, CO 33, BTN 50, SB 43, source triple S3 (6-max inferred, NL10
online, PokerStrategy), VERIFIED with M1's format caveat. Calibration is
in the spec's _doc.
postflop.continue_ref 2.0 (base 0.55): APPROXIMATE, no verified source.
It lowers how often the LAG raises when bet into (facing nodes only;
c-bets are not affected), toward the judgement band 10-20%. Measured,
flop+turn+river pooled: 30.9% [29.6, 32.2] of 5,031 faced bets before,
0.11 on 0.33/0.5/0.75/1.0): APPROXIMATE, no verified source. This flat
block is replaced whole by the merge. It sizes every post-flop raise, and
the target is raises of 4x the bet or more at most 10% with a median of
2.5-3.5x: before 25.7% at 4x or more, median 3.00x (1,554 raises); after
4.5%, median 2.66x (709 raises). The 1.0 size is dropped because it is
the main source of 4x-plus raises; the large band (0.75 + 1.0) stays at
the 0.10 floor that test_persona_size_ecology.py requires, as do small
and medium.
SIDE EFFECT, accepted by the project owner (2026-09-30): the same flat
block sizes the LAG's leads, probes and stabs (bets made when it is not
the last aggressor), so those shrink too: mean 0.61 of pot before, 0.49
after.
Dropping the 1.0 size also lowers the bluff weighting on the LAG's leads and raises when it is not the aggressor (size-weighted bluff factor about 1.022 to 0.954, roughly 7% fewer bluffs there).
Not touched: `sizing_by_node` (its `raise` node is never read by a bot)
and the pre-flop `sizing` block (open 3.0, 3-bet 3.5, 4-bet 2.4).
